locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure, zero extension, and the source-limit normalization
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, retained inside m_lambda before positive and negative parts are formed
locked_conventions.determinant_normalization: nonzero scalar rescaling is allowed only when carried explicitly; it preserves the finite zero set but not an uncontrolled limiting amplitude
locked_conventions.source_normalization: 4*hat(k_lambda^+) tends to Xi; unit-normalizing h_lambda is rejected

locked_formulas.projective_bridge: for d=s*xi-kappa, weighted projection error plus a*sqrt(L)*lambda^eta*||P_M d|| and a*lambda^eta*sqrt(L/M)*||(I-P_M)d|| tending to zero imply locally uniform convergence of 4*a*s*hat(xi) to Xi
locked_formulas.lambda_scale_projective_target: M=ceil(lambda), inf_s ||P_M(s*xi-kappa)||=O(lambda^(-1/2)), and ||P_M xi||>=c0 are sufficient together with the proved projection rate
locked_formulas.quotient_inverse: for onto W:X->K and B=A-U*I>0, W*(W^*B*W)^dagger*W^*=B^(-1)
locked_formulas.lambda_scale_coercivity_obstruction: the existing source-triangle bound satisfies g_(lambda,ceil(lambda))<0 and its nonnegative-floor cutoff is at least ceil(2*exp(1/(2*pi))*lambda^(16*(lambda-1)))-1
locked_formulas.trace_moment_equivalence: local uniform convergence of Xi(i*sigma)*f_j/f_j(i*sigma) to Xi is equivalent to tr(K_j^m)->tau_m(sigma) for every m>=1, where tau_m=-(m-1)!^(-1)*d^m/dt^m log(Psi_sigma)(0)
locked_formulas.fourier_lattice_tail: T_m(L,N)<=((L/(2*pi))^(2*m))*N^(1-2*m)/(2*m-1), so N/L^2->infinity kills every tail moment
locked_formulas.normal_family_countermodel: for the diagonal Cauchy matrix with simple kernel V_0, tr(K)=L*coth(sigma*L/2)/(4*sigma)-1/(2*sigma^2), which diverges like L/(4*sigma)
locked_formulas.odd_residual_projection: hat(R)=Pi_lambda((m_lambda-tau)*hat(p)), with Pi_lambda the sinc Paley-Wiener projection
locked_formulas.odd_nu_decomposition: mu*nu_(lambda,beta)=P_(lambda,beta)-N_(lambda,beta), and both P and N are strictly positive for locked lambda>=5/2 and beta>=0
locked_formulas.odd_sign_regions: m_lambda(t)-beta<=-(delta_Gamma+Sigma_lambda+beta) on |t|<=min(1/4,pi/(3*L)), while m_lambda(t)-beta>=1 beyond the displayed finite threshold T_(lambda,beta)
